question: Why does the all-knowing Lord not enter ordinary practical usage?
premises: The Lord is all-knowing and of nonconceptual nature.
Even as perceptual in nature, he does not become an object of ordinary usage.
inference: Therefore the Lord's nonconceptual awareness does not directly function in ordinary practical dealings.
plain_english: The all-knowing Lord, whose nature is nonconceptual and even perceptual, does not enter into ordinary practical usage.
